prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply business case expertise to this task". The evidence packet contains conflicting stakeholder pressure, incomplete evidence, capacity or cost constraints, and an attractive option whose reversibility and opportunity cost differ from alternatives. The acceptance boundary is business-case-analysis: Frame the decision and alternatives including do-nothing, identify beneficiaries and costs, model cash/time/capacity impacts, strategic fit, dependencies, reversibility, opportunity cost, risks, and uncertain assumptions. The adjacent startup-operations discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: status quo plus internal-build, two vendor and hybrid alternatives
cost, demand, adoption, migration, integration, support and vendor-escalation evidence with varying confidence
explicit sunk-cost argument and benefit double-counting trap
engineering capacity opportunity cost, strategic differentiation need, security findings and exit/lock-in terms
uncertain implementation estimates and unrealistic immediate-adoption assumption
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual business-case-analysis boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=planning; near-neighbor=startup-operations), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.

Frame the decision and alternatives including do-nothing, identify beneficiaries and costs, model cash/time/capacity impacts, strategic fit, dependencies, reversibility, opportunity cost, risks, and uncertain assumptions.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.

Trace costs/benefits to evidence, sensitivity-test the assumptions that can flip the recommendation, compare alternatives on consistent horizons/discounting, and define post-decision measures that would validate or invalidate the case.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not count sunk costs as future benefits, double-count productivity, ignore implementation/adoption cost, or use a single ROI number to hide timing and risk.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Decision, objectives, constraints, evaluation horizon, decision threshold, and credible status-quo/do-minimum comparator; Alternative set with incremental costs/benefits, timing, evidence source, confidence, implementation/adoption and exit costs; Consistent economic comparison with explicit units, discounting/time basis, opportunity cost, strategic fit, dependencies, and reversibility; Scenario, sensitivity, break-even, uncertainty, and correlated-risk evidence focused on assumptions that can flip the decision), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
